title: Getting Medicine
summary: Шүд нь өвдсөн Том эмийн сангаас өвдөлт намдаах эм авч байгаа нь.

source.name: LIDA Stories
source.credit: Written by Espen Stranger-Johannessen, illustrated by Sara Rumen Krotev · LIDA Stories

changes: Images and audio removed; the picture-book pages were joined into paragraphs (one page per paragraph, with very short pages of the same scene merged).

questions.prompt: Why does Tom go to the pharmacy?
questions.explain: Эхэнд "Tom has a toothache" гэж бичсэн. Шүдний эмчид очихоосоо өмнө өвдөлтөө намдаах юм хэрэгтэй болсон.

questions.prompt: How much do the painkillers cost?
questions.explain: Эмийн сангийн ажилтан "They cost nine euros" гэж хэлсэн.

questions.prompt: Who can give Tom a prescription for stronger medicine?
questions.explain: "You will need to get a prescription from your dentist or doctor" гэж хэлсэн. Prescription гэдэг нь эмчийн жор.
